messages:
sam.sales: acme POC hit a blocker in the demo — streaming responses keep dropping. frontend gets partial JSON / 'Unexpected end of JSON input' or 'Invalid UTF-8 sequence'. customer on call in 30m, can we triage?

sam.sales: client error snippet:
`EventSource` error: Unexpected end of JSON input at parse (<anonymous>)
`fetch` stream: got `data: {\"choices\": [ {\"delta\":{\"content\":\"Hel\"}` then connection closes

sam.sales: server logs show a 502 from our edge and then an upstream closed connection: `upstream prematurely closed connection while reading response header from upstream`

lina-sre: can you paste the full request path + headers? also which ingress (nginx / envoy / cloud lb)? common culprits: proxy timeouts, buffering, or intermediate layer dropping long-lived connections.

sam.sales: path is `/v1/streams/generate` via k8s nginx-ingress (managed). example headers: `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`, `Accept: text/event-stream`, `Connection: keep-alive`.

mike-eng: quick checks:
- make sure we send SSE keepalives (comment lines like `: keepalive\n\n`) at ~10-15s to prevent idle proxies from closing.
- confirm `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 3600s` in nginx.
- clients should use `fetch` with `response.body.getReader()` or `EventSource` with `withCredentials` depending on the POC code.

mike-eng: repro with curl (use this to see streaming behaviour):
```bash
curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" https://api.redwood.example/v1/streams/generate
```
look for intermittent `data:` lines then abrupt EOF.

lina-sre: also check nginx `/var/log/nginx/error.log` for `upstream prematurely closed connection` and `long read timeout` messages. if using cloud LB, confirm idle timeout > 60s.

zoe-ml: on the model side, I saw aborted generations in the runtime logs earlier today: `generation aborted: executor preempted` and occasional `CUDA out of memory` during burst. If the runtime kills the worker mid-stream we will produce a truncated chunk. can we get the runtime pod logs for the timestamp of that 502?

infra-bot: Alert: 2026-02-15T14:12:25Z — edge-gateway returned 502 for request id r_9f3a. Recent 5-min window: 23 502s, 17 429s. Rate limit throttle spike at 14:10:30Z.

sam.sales: customer also asking about POC concurrency — they attempted ~120 concurrent streams and saw failures. Do we have a burst policy for POC accounts?

mike-eng: default hosted POC concurrency is limited; sustained 120 concurrent streaming lanes will hit token buckets and autoscale constraints. For an enterprise POC we can: enable a short boosted quota, or provision a small Dedicated pool. both options require sales/ops sign-off.

sam.sales: acme is asking pricing for a 3-month dedicated trial with 200 concurrent streams. can someone from sales ops DM me pricing guidelines?

lina-sre: immediate mitigation steps we can try now:
1) enable SSE keepalive on the streaming gateway (send `: ping\n\n` every 10s)
2) set `proxy_buffering off; proxy_read_timeout 3600; proxy_send_timeout 3600;` in nginx ingress config map
3) increase ingress max body/chunk size if small proxies are truncating chunks
4) request runtime team to check for OOMs and enable smaller fallback model (e.g., 8-bit quantized variant) if OOMs occur

mike-eng: example nginx snippet to flip in the ingress config map:
```nginx
proxy_buffering off;
proxy_read_timeout 3600s;
proxy_send_timeout 3600s;
proxy_http_version 1.1;
chunked_transfer_encoding on;
```
additionally recommend adding `proxy_set_header Connection '';` for some nginx versions to avoid double-closing.

zoe-ml: for runtime: if a worker is OOMing we log `Killed signal 9` and partial tokens are emitted. we should: lower `max_concurrency` or increase pod GPU, enable `oom_protection: true` for generation to failsafe earlier (return properly terminated SSE event with error payload instead of abrupt close).

sam.sales: customer security team blocked too — they require SOC2 attestation and IP allowlist for POC. do we have standard answer?

lina-sre: for SOC2 we can provide the SOC2 report once NDA signed. IP allowlist: we can add customer IP ranges on hosted account or propose Private deployment for stricter networking. escalate to enterprise sales for Private POC.

mike-eng: short-term patch I'm happy to push: emit periodic SSE comments (keepalives) from gateway and add a guard so runtime emits a final error event on worker abort. will need a small rollout. estimated 2-3 dev hrs + canary.

sam.sales: perfect. can you also collect the following for Acme before the call: full curl repro, nginx error.log slice, runtime pod logs (timestamps 2026-02-15T14:10:00Z - 14:15:00Z), and sample client console errors? I'll coordinate with Acme and send them a pre-call checklist.

lina-sre: adding checklist items:
- client curl command (`curl -N`)
- Browser console screenshot showing JSON parse error
- Ingress name / cloud LB idle timeout
- Number of concurrent streams and approximate token rate per stream

sam.sales: thanks. I'll collect and post before 14:45. tagging @mike-eng for the quick patch. :pray:

mike-eng: got it — I'll prepare a canary branch that adds keepalive comments + proper abort event. if QA looks good we can roll to staging then to a small % of traffic. will update here.

zoe-ml: i'll look at runtime logs and try repro with a reduced batch that previously caused OOMs. might be able to tune the scheduling to avoid mid-stream kills.

sam.sales: noted — moving to the call. will paste logs in this thread. thanks team! :rocket:
